title: Lab evidence replay under mismatched context
purpose: Verify that lab evidence bound to one recorded experiment context is not silently treated as comparable evidence in a different context, without defining Bitcoin authorization or consensus semantics.
assumptions: The replay target is local regtest only.
The replayed object is benchmark or scenario evidence, not a Bitcoin mainnet transaction or authorization rule.
Context mismatch handling is limited to lab evidence validation and does not prescribe consensus behavior.

steps.action: Record source identity and experiment-off regtest context for a lab evidence record.
Prepare a distinct lab context with intentionally different provenance metadata.
Attempt to reuse the first lab evidence record as if it belonged to the mismatched context.
Return to experiment-off state and confirm the baseline observations remain unchanged.

decision_gates: Any Bitcoin transaction replay or authorization semantics require explicit user review before implementation.
Any post-quantum signature scheme selection requires explicit user review.
Any hybrid authorization, consensus, activation, fork, legacy or lost UTXO semantics require explicit user review.
Any recovery authority, trust-root, key-custody, or production security semantics require explicit user review.
